harper (eng-platform): Heads-up — we flipped sampling for billing telemetry in canary and a few customers reported sudden invoice increases. Spun up this thread to triage.

lee (devex): getting support threads. They see per-route billing spikes but console request counts look stable. Looks like tokens attributed differently.

aj (sdk-python): quick context: py-sdk 2.5 switched embedding batching and now emits fewer, larger embedding requests. That alone shouldn't change per-route billing unless ingestion changed sampling semantics.

nina (sdk-ts): ts-sdk added sampling hint header `X-Redwood-Sample: p=0.02` in 4.0. That was meant to adjust observability telemetry only, not billing. Could the new sampler accidentally gate billing events?

omar (console): console shows billing rows keyed by (tenant, route_id, sample_bucket). Our ingestion pipeline added `sample_bucket` to telemetry last week to allow sampled logs to be correlated, but it looks like billing joins on that field now due to a misplaced join in pipeline v2.

harper (eng-platform): ah. So when sample_bucket flips between SDK versions or sampling hints, the same logical route gets split across buckets and the billing aggregation errs on summing per-bucket charges instead of deduping by request id. That's bad.

billing-bot: billing-pipeline alert: join-cardinality-growth detected (alert-3001)

lee (devex): customers see 2–3x apparent token burn because their embedding batches are chunked differently and the sample_bucket varies per batch. We need short-term rollback and a permanent fix.

aj (sdk-python): we can revert batching behavior in py-sdk patch 2.5.1 but that doesn't help customers pinned to 2.5.0. Also embedding batch size shouldn't change token accounting server-side.

nina (sdk-ts): TS can stop sending the sampling hint header by default (toggle off) in 4.0.1. But root cause seems server-side.

omar (console): mitigation options: 1) ingestion hotfix to join on canonical request_id before grouping, 2) console patch to ignore sample_bucket when computing billed tokens, 3) rollback sampling change in pipeline. My vote is ingestion hotfix + console guard.

harper (eng-platform): agree. Ingestion hotfix to compute canonical_request_id = request_id || dedup_key(tenant, timestamp_window, route_id) and perform dedupe before aggregation. Keep hotfix behind a fast rollback.

billing-bot: hotfix runbook prepared (rb-501). Estimated time to patch: 90m.

lee (devex): I'll post a terse status update to affected customers: "We observed billing attribution artifacts caused by sampling change in our telemetry pipeline. We're fixing grouping logic and will reverse incorrect charges if any are billed. ETA ~2h."

aj (sdk-python): also will add a small SDK-side idempotency key for embeddings so server can reliably dedupe if duplicate batches occur: `X-Redwood-Idempotency: sha256(tenant+route+batch-window+seq)` in 2.5.1. Will include migration note.

nina (sdk-ts): we'll add the same in TS 4.0.1 and document sampling hint semantics clearly.

omar (console): console guard: treat `sample_bucket` as a non-billing dimension unless `billing_mode=explicit` is set. I'll open a PR and toggle in canary.

harper (eng-platform): good. Longer term: change billing join to use canonical_request_id and stop relying on ephemeral sampling dimensions. Also update the API and SDK docs: sampling hints are observability-only and must not affect billing joins.

lee (devex): action items: 1) harper/infra — apply ingestion hotfix (90m). 2) omar — console guard PR (canary first). 3) aj/nina — SDK idempotency header release (EOD). 4) me — customer note and FAQ.

billing-bot: hotfix deployed to canary cluster (deploy-rc-5) :rocket:

harper (eng-platform): monitor metrics: billed_tokens_by_tenant should converge to baseline within 30m of hotfix; if not, prepare rollback.

lee (devex): thanks all. I'll draft the status page blurb and link to migration snippets once SDK patches are out.

aj (sdk-python): sample code for migration note:```
# py-sdk idempotency example
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
batch_key = c.make_batch_key(tenant, route_id, window_start)
headers = {"X-Redwood-Idempotency": batch_key}
# send embeddings with header so server can dedupe
c.embeddings(..., headers=headers)
```

nina (sdk-ts): similar snippet will be in TS changelog.

harper (eng-platform): reconvene in 2h or sooner if alerts persist. :eyes:
